metadata.title: Synthetic geostatistics case studies for mining and oil & gas
metadata.description:
Six synthetic 2D and 3D datasets, each built around a situation real geostatistics projects face. One zip per dataset; each holds a README describing every file and column (units, ranges, missing values) and suggested exercises.

  • coal-seam: 295 boreholes, infill drilled where the seam is thick (preferential sampling, declustering, anisotropy, trend).
  • seismic-guided-porosity: 55 wells and an exhaustive seismic grid (collocated cokriging, depth conversion, clustered wells).
  • deviated-well-logs: 22 deviated wells with logs, tops and a seismic horizon (petrophysics, heterotopic logs).
  • gold-veins: four steep veins, 118 drill holes and 2 492 channels (extreme skewness, top-cut, indicators, thin domains).
  • zinc-vms-lenses: three dipping polymetallic lenses cut by 289 holes (multivariate, density, domains, solids).
  • iron-formation: exploration holes and blastholes over the same deposit (change of support, heterotopic cokriging, closure, block model).

Conventions: CSV with a header row, empty cell = not measured; local coordinates in metres, Z elevation positive up; units in column names; solids are closed binary STL.
